This is a complete list of all 50 [[U.S. state]]s, its federal ([[Washington, D.C.]]) and its major [[Territories of the United States|territories]] ordered by total area, land area and water area.<ref>{{cite web |url = https://www.census.gov/geographies/reference-files/2010/geo/state-area.html |title = State Area Measurements and Internal Point Coordinates |date = 2010 |website = census.gov |access-date = 2 Dec 2023}}</ref> The water area includes [[inland waters]], [[coastal waters]], the [[Great Lakes]] and [[territorial waters]]. [[Glacier]]s and intermittent bodies of water are counted as land area.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://www2.census.gov/geo/pdfs/reference/glossry2.pdf |title=Census 2000 Geographic Terms and Concepts |work=Census 2000 Geography Glossary |publisher=U.S. Census Bureau |access-date=July 10, 2007}}</ref>

File:US States by Water Area.svg|U.S. states by water area
File:US States by Water Percentage.svg|U.S. states by water percentage
File:Map of USA AK full.png|[[Alaska]] is the largest state by total area, land area, and water area. It is the [[List of first-level administrative divisions by area|seventh-largest country division in the world]].
File:Alaska area compared to conterminous US.svg|The area of Alaska is {{percentage|665384.04|3796742.22|0}} of the area of the United States and equivalent to {{percentage|665384.04|3120426.47|0}} of the area of the [[contiguous United States]].
File:Texas in United States.svg|The second largest state, [[Texas]], has {{percentage|268596.46|665384.04|0}} of the total area of the largest state, Alaska.
File:Rhode Island in United States (zoom) (extra close).svg|[[Rhode Island]] is the smallest state by total area and land area.
File:Map of California highlighting San Bernardino County.svg|[[San Bernardino County, California|San Bernardino County]] is the largest [[county (United States)|county]] in the [[Contiguous United States|contiguous U.S.]] and is larger than each of the nine smallest states.
File:STS-95 Florida From Space.jpg|[[Florida]] is mostly a peninsula, and has the third-largest water area and seventh-largest water area percentage.
</gallery>
